resolved_suspects.description: Watcom loop-unrolled strcpy (2-byte-at-a-time do-while with mid-body null check). Replace the whole loop with strcpy() in a .keep.

Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `pCVar19` self-updates via pointer arithmetic on an inner array field reached through a chained field path; the array decays to a pointer and `+ CONST` adds `CONST * sizeof(element)` bytes, matching the outer array stride. Replace `pCVar19->some_field[0]` reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update.

Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `pCVar18` self-updates via byte arithmetic on a sibling field, where the chosen field/index/constant sum to one element-size step. Replace `pCVar18->bone_list[0]` (or whatever) reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update.

patterns.impact: Causes ESP-relative offsets to become runtime-dependent. All stack variables accessed via ESP after this point will appear as separate "in_stack_XXXX" parameters.
